name: Meridian After Midnight
creator: AxiomMedia Entertainment Division; hosted by Seraphina Okubo-Brennan
description: A slick, corporate-produced comedy podcast that bills itself as 'the city talking to itself after the workday ends' — a nightly thirty-minute blend of satirical news commentary, celebrity interviews, and sketch comedy delivered in the warm, razor-precise voice of host Seraphina Okubo-Brennan, a former Tier 3 stand-up comedian who was recruited (and substantially augmented) by AxiomMedia in 2214. The show is genuinely funny, which makes its careful avoidance of any subject that might embarrass its parent company all the more unsettling to those who notice it.
medium: neural feed audio / premium BCI stream with embedded haptic laugh track
cultural_impact: Meridian After Midnight is the most-subscribed comedy podcast in M88 with 34 million neural feed subscribers, making Okubo-Brennan one of the most recognizable voices in the city; critics argue its popularity actively crowds out independent comedy by defining the genre's aesthetic for an entire generation of listeners.
controversy: A leaked internal memo from AxiomMedia's content compliance division, published by Null Dispatch in 2218, revealed a running list of 'prohibited satirical targets' that included all AxiomMedia subsidiaries, HelixCorp, four named Spire families, and — pointedly — Scar Tissue Radio. Okubo-Brennan has never publicly commented on the memo.
story_hooks: Okubo-Brennan's personal BCI has recorded something it was not supposed to — something that happened in the green room before a live taping — and she is desperately trying to have it scrubbed before AxiomMedia's routine content audit.
An underground comedian has written a pitch-perfect parody of Meridian After Midnight that names the prohibited targets; they need it distributed before AxiomMedia's legal team finds them.
A guest scheduled for tomorrow's episode has information that would end three careers at the top of AxiomMedia — and someone has just tried to cancel their transportation to the studio.
